request.description: WINGS STAY STILL in their exact reference position: this dragon WALKS ON THE GROUND, never flies or lifts its wings. Animate a slow FOUR-LEGGED WALK in place, alternating diagonal weight-bearing steps with bending knees. Chest and hips breathe, tail sways. Rider remains firmly seated with face always visible. No rearing, no airborne forelegs, no raised wings. Exact approved rider and mount, same costume, colours, face and proportions, facing right, fixed camera. Preserve eyes with coloured iris and white highlight; no black empty eyes. Rider remains seated and hands retain reins or book. Far rider leg stays hidden; near wing stays in FRONT of lower rider hair/body consistently, below the face. Never move a wing across the face. No extra limbs, symbols, background, speed lines, exterior magic or particles. Return seamlessly to reference pose.
